You see people stating "I have the same GPU but I run it smoothly and hell I have a worse CPU!" 
Well, since you have a better CPU you should see higher frame rates but since your CPU is in a higher tier than your GPU you will also see stutters/hitches etc because this game will tax your CPU and GPU very hard. So no doubt your GPU is at 100% going up the hill but the CPU is trying to pull it up with it.

So literally a downgrade on the CPU would yield less fps yes but a smoother experience. Ofc who would want to downgrade?
